ai.headline: Roblox adds UGC Subscriptions, paid with real money, that renew automatically
ai.summary: Roblox's terms now cover UGC Subscriptions, which Creators offer to Users for extra benefits, bought with real money and renewing automatically until cancelled. Purchases are non-refundable and non-transferable, and Roblox can charge the payment method on file. Other changes add that Creators must handle sales disputes, remove the Creator-to-Creator copying complaint process in favor of DMCA-style takedown reports, and drop the English-is-primary statement.
